title: TEST CHAMBER 08
pa: Welcome to the equipment reassignment programme.
The service stairs are not part of your scheduled test.

addedBoxes.note: First discreet maintenance step; top at 0.60 m.
Second service step; top at 1.30 m.
Third service step; top at 2.00 m.
Fourth service step; top at 2.70 m.
Fifth service step; top at 3.40 m.
High staff walkway to the east hatch; underside remains above y = 3.
Fix: staff bridge from the high walkway north to the shell catwalk at the real staff hatch (z -4.5); the walkway alone dead-ends at the wall above the door.

solution: Possess the arm and press the heavy button at (-4.2, 1.5, 2) to open the shutter and staff hatch.
Possess the drone and zap the high north-east panel to enable override.
Use the arm to carry the heavy crate from (-3.1, 0.55, -1.9) to the floor plate at (1.8, -1.4); do not throw it.
Possess the base and walk out through the east door at z = 3.8 to 6.2.
Hidden: after the button, override and plate, jump the five south-side maintenance steps (0.60, 1.30, 2.00, 2.70 and 3.40 m) and walk the upper ledge through the open staff hatch above y = 3.
